videos.title: I Built a Pinball Game Where You Bounce Off the Moon 🌕
videos.description:
Moon Bounce is gravity pinball played against the moon. Light every star to climb a stage, and when you fall through the flippers you only drop back one. This run starts at the top.

Game designed by Seiler Asterces. Free to play, link on the channel page.

videos.title: Ember Ascent: 0 to 180, a New Best 🔥 #shorts
videos.description:
One ember, one tap at a time. This run climbs from 0 past Spark, Blaze and Starfire, falls, rises again, and beats the old best of 124 with a new high of 180.

Ember Ascent is a one-tap vertical arcade game of orbits and glyphs. Tap to leap from ring to ring and keep the ember rising.

Play it free: link on the channel page.

Game coded and played by Seiler Asterces.
